name: Traditions of the Bluff
summary: A Tauren tradition asks you to scatter incense from Hunter’s Rise. The offering may honor the Earthmother, a hunt, an occasion, or a search for guidance.

sections.title: Incense to the Winds
sections.body: A Tauren at Hunter’s Rise asks you to honor a tradition of scattering incense to the winds. You gather herbs, cedar twigs, sinew thread, and ceremonial flint and tinder from the named suppliers. At the ceremonial site, you combine them and scatter the incense from the south-facing cliff.

sections.title: Many Occasions
sections.body: Incense may be scattered to ask the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, mark an occasion, or seek guidance from the ancestors. The act is reverent, though it need not follow a single ceremony. Different tribes observe different traditional steps.

faq.q: What is the tradition at Hunter’s Rise?
faq.answer: The tradition is to scatter incense to the winds from the south-facing cliff of Hunter’s Rise.

faq.q: What can the incense offering be for?
faq.answer: It may ask the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or offer guidance from the ancestors.

faq.q: What do I need to make the incense?
faq.answer: The components are herbs, cedar twigs, sinew thread, and ceremonial flint and tinder.
The ceremonial site is on the south-facing cliff of Hunter’s Rise.

faq.q: Do all tribes perform the tradition the same way?
faq.answer: No. Different tribes may observe different traditional steps, and the act is not strictly ceremonial.

angles.text: As a Tauren, you honor a tradition that may invoke the Earthmother or seek guidance from your ancestors.
